<thought>I need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the described cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. Using the flavanone SMILES “O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12”, I will search the template catalog for templates that break a ketone and form an ether oxygen, which matches the forward reaction description.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
